subject: PrivateNet preflight: egress ownership & IP allowlist confirmation
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@fintrust.com>, networking@fintrust.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: PrivateNet preflight: egress ownership & IP allowlist confirmation

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks we agreed: 

- Deployment mode: FinTrust prefers a Private VPC (PrivateNet) to meet compliance. You also asked for a short comparison between PrivateLink vs VPC peering for your network team — we'll include that in the workshop.
- Networking ownership: we need to confirm whether FinTrust will manage outbound egress/NAT and public IP allowlist, or if Redwood will provide a managed egress IP range. This affects firewall rules and routing.
- IP / FQDN allowlist: please share the public egress IPs (or a CIDR block) and any hostnames that must be reachable. If you prefer PrivateLink, we'll need the platform endpoint settings and hostnames.
- KMS / data residency: you asked whether customer-managed keys are supported on PrivateNet — yes, we support KMS integration; we'll validate the exact KMS provider during the preflight.

Attached: redwood-vpc-preflight-template.xlsx — could you have your NetOps team fill the "Network inventory" tab before the workshop? That will cut the session time in half.

Proposed next steps:
1) NetOps workshop (90m): go over IPs, routing, firewall rules, and PrivateLink vs peering decision matrix.
2) FinTrust returns the preflight template by EOD Wed (2027-09-22).
3) Redwood prepares an outline of the PrivateNet architecture and a fallback plan to Dedicated capacity if peering can't be established.

Available times for the workshop this week: Wed 09/22 9:00–10:30 PT, Thu 09/23 13:00–14:30 PT. Pick one and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: redwood-vpc-preflight-template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@fintrust.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@fintrust.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2027 18:01:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PrivateNet preflight: egress ownership & IP allowlist confirmation

On Sun, Sep 19, 2027 at 3:12 PM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Jordan — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks we agreed: 
> 
> - Deployment mode: FinTrust prefers a Private VPC (PrivateNet) to meet compliance. You also asked for a short comparison between PrivateLink vs VPC peering for your network team — we'll include that in the workshop.

Thanks Evelyn — that summary looks right. Adding Aisha (NetOps) to the thread so she can own the template and the IP list. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Preliminary egress CIDR we can provide: 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.0/28 (these will be final after we validate with our firewall team).
- We prefer PrivateLink for cross-account connectivity if latency stays under 30ms; if PrivateLink requires more operational overhead we'll consider VPC peering.
- KMS: we use a cloud KMS (vendor-side) and can provide key ARNs; confirm the integration steps.

We can do the workshop Thu 09/23 13:00–14:30 PT — that works for NetOps. I'll ask Aisha to fill the template before the meeting.

Jordan
VP, Platform Engineering | FinTrust
jordan.mills@fintrust.com
Attachment: initial-network-topology.png (image, 450KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivateNet preflight: egress ownership & IP allowlist confirmation

Thanks — great. Confirming internal owners and immediate asks: 

1) Marissa (me): run the NetOps workshop on Thu 09/23 13:00–14:30 PT. I'll send the calendar invite to Jordan/Aisha and include a short agenda:
   - 10m overview of Redwood PrivateNet modes
   - 25m PrivateLink vs peering decision criteria
   - 30m IP allowlist / routing diagram review
   - 25m action items & next steps

2) Ben: can you prepare a 1-page fallback plan for Dedicated capacity (latency, cost delta, timeline) in case FinTrust requires a temporary fallback? They asked about SLA impact if peering cannot be established.

3) Evelyn: attach the preflight template here in the invite and add a link to the HubSpot deal record so NetOps can reference the procurement timeline. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FT-2027-Q3-43

Checklist items for the workshop (please confirm these with Jordan/Aisha beforehand):
- Final public egress CIDRs / static IPs (they provided preliminary ranges; need confirmation).
- Which team will own NAT/egress (FinTrust NetOps or Redwood-managed egress).
- Firewall/open port list and destination FQDNs.
- KMS provider details and whether customer-managed keys will be used.
- Any proxy or TLS inspection in front of the endpoints.

Also adding a DocuSign placeholder for the standard PrivateNet SOW (procurement will want this available asap): https://www.docusign.com/en/FT-2027-43/signature-request

-Marissa
Principal Customer Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: redwood-vpc-preflight-template.xlsx (please ensure FinTrust uploads the filled file before the call)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivateNet preflight: egress ownership & IP allowlist confirmation

Ack — I'll draft the Dedicated fallback memo this morning. Quick notes: 
- If FinTrust manages NAT, we should confirm they can announce the static egress IPs and support asymmetric routing for KV cache traffic.
- If Redwood needs to provide managed egress, we'll propose two static IPs per region (primary + standby) and document failover.

Will post the one-pager in the HubSpot deal thread by 12:00 PT.

-Ben
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
notes: NetOps workshop scheduled; FinTrust to return preflight template. Internal owners: Marissa (workshop), Ben (fallback plan), Evelyn (SE lead).
